content_sections.heading: About District Social Welfare Office, Tirunelveli
content_sections.text: The District Social Welfare Office in Tirunelveli comes under the Social Welfare and Women Rights Department. The District Women Empowerment Centre, where these posts are based, works from this office. The centre works for the advancement of women, helps them become entrepreneurs, and spreads awareness of safety helpline numbers and of issues such as the prevention of child marriage.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Both posts are temporary and are filled on a contract basis. The place of work is the District Women Empowerment Centre, which functions under the District Social Welfare Office, Tirunelveli.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Social Welfare Office, Tirunelveli Accounts Assistant and Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the Tirunelveli district website . Fill in the form. Attach your bio-data and copies of the documents relevant to the post you are applying for. Send the application by post or hand it in by 13 November 2026 at this address: District Social Welfare Officer, District Social Welfare Office, Manimuthar Complex, First Floor, District Collectorate Campus, Tirunelveli District. For further details, contact the District Social Welfare Office directly at the same address.

faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only people belonging to Tirunelveli district can apply, and they must also meet the qualification and experience required for the post.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification does the Accounts Assistant post need?
faq.answer: You need any degree or diploma with Accounts as a subject, plus 3 years of Accounts experience.

faq.question: Q3. Is computer knowledge needed for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Yes. The post requires any degree and computer knowledge, along with 3 years of experience in information technology.

faq.question: Q4. Does private-sector experience count?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice accepts experience from Government, NGO and private sectors for both posts.

faq.question: Q5. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The notice describes them as temporary posts filled on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q6. Can I hand in the application in person?
faq.answer: Yes. You can deliver it to the District Social Welfare Office on the first floor of the Manimuthar Complex in the District Collectorate Campus, or send it by post.

faq.question: Q7. What should I send with the form?
faq.answer: Send your bio-data and copies of the documents relevant to the post you are applying for.
